gettingStarted.title: Get started
gettingStarted.intro: Your candidates stay private. MissionHub matches them with jobs from partner recruiters, you decide who to submit, and the commission is tracked when someone gets hired.

candidate.title: Add your first candidate
candidate.description: Add someone you represent, or import a list from a CSV. Only you can see them.

matching.title: Turn on matching for a candidate
matching.description: Record their permission, then turn on matching so MissionHub can look for partner jobs that fit.

job.title: Publish a job open to partners
job.description: Have an open role? Publish it so partner recruiters can refer their candidates to you.

referral.title: Submit a candidate to a partner job
referral.description: Review a match, check the fit, and submit when your candidate agrees.
